scenario_descriptions.busy-background: 1-3 tags on text, shapes, or checkerboards
scenario_descriptions.clutter-only: Shapes, text, checkerboards, or natural texture with no tag
scenario_descriptions.dark-background: 1-3 tags on a dark or mid-grey background, 36-140 px
scenario_descriptions.decoys: Black-bordered squares with random payloads; none is a valid code
scenario_descriptions.empty: Uniform frame at a random brightness, light noise
scenario_descriptions.frame-edge: 1-3 tags whose quiet zone touches the frame edge
scenario_descriptions.large-tags: One tag filling 45-80% of the frame height
scenario_descriptions.low-contrast: Black and white only 40-90 grey levels apart
scenario_descriptions.many-tags: 2-12 tags of mixed sizes on mixed backgrounds
scenario_descriptions.motion-blur: Linear motion blur, 3-11 px (odd lengths) in any direction
scenario_descriptions.noise: Gaussian sensor noise, sigma 4-14 grey levels
scenario_descriptions.noise-free: 1-3 tags on a plain background with no sensor noise at all
scenario_descriptions.one-tag: One tag, any angle, mild tilt, uniform background
scenario_descriptions.small-tags: 1-4 tags with a 32-53 px black square
scenario_descriptions.steep-angle: 1-3 tags tilted 40-65 degrees away from the camera
scenario_descriptions.underexposed: Dark frame: everything scaled to 15-35% brightness, then noise
scenario_descriptions.uneven-light: Lighting gradient (30-60% at the dark end) plus vignetting

scope: Detector call only, on pre-rendered uint8 grayscale frames. Every frame is distinct. Corner error is the worst corner's Euclidean distance from exact ground truth; AprilTag corners are shifted -0.5 px to the pixel-centre convention and re-ordered to the truth before scoring.
